patterns.note: The site uses a clean, spacious layout with full-bleed hero sections and centrally aligned content within modals, emphasizing product imagery and bold typography.

A strong typographic hierarchy is established using a bold, uppercase sans-serif for primary headings, a lighter sans-serif for body text, and a distinct monospaced font for functional elements like weather and shipping notices.

The color palette primarily consists of muted grays, black, and white, providing a sophisticated backdrop for product photography, with a vibrant blue used sparingly as an accent color for product details.

A full-page, dark overlay modal appears immediately on page load, obscuring the main content and presenting a survey. No scroll-triggered motion is observable on the main page from the provided sequence.
The hero section features large, high-quality product photography set against a subtle gradient background, with prominent, high-contrast text overlays and a clear call-to-action button.

technique_notes: A full-page modal is triggered on initial page load, likely using CSS keyframes or JavaScript to fade in a semi-transparent dark background and reveal the survey content. The modal content itself is static once displayed.
Hero sections utilize full-width product photography with a subtle background gradient, overlaid with bold, white text and a call-to-action button to ensure high readability and visual impact.

Typography is managed with a clear hierarchy: large, bold, uppercase sans-serif for main titles, a lighter sans-serif for supporting text, and a monospaced font for specific informational details, creating distinct visual roles for different text types.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, lighter sans-serif body text. Monospaced text is used for functional details.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on elements like buttons and the cookie banner, with slightly more rounded, pill-like shapes for interactive elements within the modal.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with significant whitespace around the hero content and ample padding within the centrally aligned modal elements.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its immediate full-page interactive survey modal on load, which is a bold approach to user engagement. It combines a clean, almost industrial aesthetic with a sophisticated use of bold typography and a muted color palette accented by a vibrant product-specific blue, creating a unique brand identity that feels both modern and grounded.
